verdict.rationale: Thoropass describes the audit as running in one platform "from scoping through final report" and pairs it with its own audit/assessor services. It has in-platform audits and evidence requests that support comments, attachments and status updates, plus a Comments Inbox that keeps control and evidence-request communication in one place instead of email. However, nothing explicitly documents a dedicated, scoped auditor role or view of controls and evidence; auditor in-platform work is only implied. Missing for 10: a documented auditor-scoped view or permission role, explicit description of auditors reviewing and accepting evidence in-app, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
